Header Title
Hello World

Crazy story actually... So I was just walking through Greenguard forest the other day, minding my own business, when I heard a TERRIBLE SOUND! It was as if the very heavens had been ripped open with an unholy and terrifying force, and so immediately I /unsheathed and turned around to face my fate.

...But there was no one there! In my confusion I looked around furiously looking for the source of the sound, but I was alone! Or so I thought. Just then, I heard a tiny "Hello" and I totally didn't almost jump out of my armor in fear. I bravely looked down and my eyes were met by this horrible creature.

That's just what he wants you to think. Trust me, this fluffy little danger football is a force to be reckoned with. 

Anyway, back to my story... I too was fooled by his cuteness and so I sheathed my swords once more.

He introduced himself as Ragnafluff The Ruinous, and told me he had come in search of a good fight and wanted to spar with me. "What a brave little moglin, you are", I told him. I of course accepted the challenge and we squared up for combat.
*shudders* The fight went on for hours. Most of it is a blur, but I will tell you what I do remember. Flashing lights, furious combat, a couple of forest fires, and at least one bathroom break.
I said "HECK NO YOU FURRY LITTLE FOOTBALL!!!" and then I used a dev command to delete his HP.

Hey it's not my fault he didn't learn how to use Unity! 

Anyway, he followed me back to town because he heard Battleon would be flooded with adventurers, and he wanted to test your mettle. 

Good luck, and no you can't have access to dev commands so you better bring some friends!

Eventually I was too tired to stand.. my strength drained, my mana spent, my canteen low, and my potions at home because I forgot to bring them.. 

...and he just stood there looking up at me with those.. horrible little innocent eyes and asked me if I give up.

I'm Ghost, nice to meet ya. I do animation and animation related things, which means mostly I make cutscenes, and sometimes I animate class skills, emotes, monsters, pets... basically anything that moves was either animated by me, Nulgath, or Korin.
Technically, yes. I think. Seems like it anyway... it's a long story.

A sculptor should begin every carving with a wash of magic, because all things mundane are magical when exposed to creativity.

I am Vinchi De'Leonardo, a sculptor and restless disciple of experience. Born in the humble town of Mythsong, my true life's work is the relentless pursuit of honoring the greatest Heroes of Lore by carving statues in their likeness. May that persevere and stand the test of the time so that future generations will know who made this world possible.

Indeed, I am eager to begin carving your form into an immortal stone statue. Alas, we must wait for the stone to arrive! 

When it does, I shall look into the shadows and light that fall upon your form and spirit, to capture your very life into rock. You will be my finest work.
Indeed. I have been tasked by King Alteon the Good to sculpt each of the Immortal, Benevolent, and Custom backers of the Kickstarter into statues.

elements.text:
Oh, hi there! This is where backers of the AdventureQuest Worlds: Infinity Kickstarter can get their rewards.

It doesn't look like you have any Kickstarter rewards.  That is why you do not see any shops below. Here is a link to the Kickstarter. Read the latest update posts for the newest information.

MYSTERIOUS STRANGER'S OFFER I hear you've already been exploring the Alpha and one of the Alpha Servers is named after you! But this is just the beginning. You're going to be called on to help create something EXTREMELY significant in this world. WORLD BUILDER What if I told you that you'll be designing a new part of the world? A new adventure, on a new map with monsters and rewards based around an NPC. Not just any NPC, but a hero or villain constructed around the custom weapon and armor set you will be building. Perhaps now would be a good time for you to start should start brainstorming what you would love to create with us.

Benevolent Founder In honor of your selfless act of sponsoring items to be fully converted to Infinity, we are making this Kickstarter tier even better for you. Originally, the Kickstarter said that "you will choose 5 items to sponsor and any item you do not have will be added to your inventory." However, we heard that many players were having a hard time choosing whether to use this to convert items they already have and love, or to sponsor an item they did not already own to get it. To solve this dilemma for you, we are giving you 5 Kickstarter Benevolent Item of Digital Awesomeness (KBloDA) tokens that you can use to get any 5 items you want from the expanded Benevolent item list. This does not sponsor the items, this just lets you get special items that you want. Then, you are also getting 5 Sponsorship tokens which you can use to sponsor the full conversion of any item in your inventory. Your name will be added to the credits section of the item (when this feature is live). This way you get the best of both worlds. Also, as part of your rewards you received 1 x Golden Item of Digital Awesomeness (GloDA) to pick an additional item you would like from the normal list of rare items. NOTES * These items are redeemed through our www.AQ.com account manager website * You must confirm your email to be able to claim the items * Decisions are final. Take your time & choose carefully!

elements.text: You never know what kind of dragon you'll be facing. As a Dragonslayer you'll need to be ready for anything. Strength, Endurance and Dexterity are key abilities for a Dragonslayer! My Enhancements should help improve those stats.
Hello World
This place gives people the creeps. But I feel right at home!
Ooooooh, this place is Bludrut Keep! They say it was once a beautiful tower. But now these ruins are the haunted home of the Groglurk.

Meh, you're just here for the loot? I knew there was something I liked about you. The Bludrut Blade is wielded by the Groglurk. 

If you want that cursed weapon, you will have to find your way alllll the way down under the keep and take it from her. Good luck, heh heh.

The Groglurk? Never seen it myself. Supposed to be a hideous thing. The source of all the curses binding the undead monsters to this place. 

Veddrian said she went in this place as a kid. Meh. I think she's lying. No one who has ever gone in there has come out. At least not alive.

Congratulations! You defeated the Boss monster. 

If you want to battle them again, you'll have to return in a little while.  They need to recover their strength, and they will not come back while you are still here.

Why not take the time to continue on your quests?
I have been waiting an eternity for someone to break my curse and restore peace to my troubled soul. The two of you working together may be just the ticket.

Hi there @name ! I'm Aranx, the Archangel, we have not officially met yet. I'm tracking down a wild manticore  that has somehow managed to escaped to your realm.

Please, join me to the Celestial Nexus, which is where I have tracked down the Manticore so far.
I'm Archangel Aranx, the artist in charge of all the spectacular remakes of our old weapons in the Infinity style and quality. I'm glad to see you using some of the weapons we have made for you.
Ah, yes, you see. I come from the Celestial Realm, a place were Archangels, and Celestials like me reside. It is too early yet to grant you a visit there. However, I do look forward to the occasion.

Ahoy mate! 

Avast! Yer a bloody Alpha Pirate!? Unbelievable! An honor ta meet ya. Just so happens I be sailing the 70 seas of lore on behalf of the infamous Captain Rhubarb. We be searching for worthy Alpha Pirates to join our crew in Lolosia. Officially speak'n, yer at the top of me list and my first order o' bidness will be upgrading that Alpha Pirate set of yers!

Arrrr interested?

Ahoy me matey!

Hold on, looking to join a pirate crew, ye say? I'm cruising the 70 seas of lore on behalf of Captain Rhubarb looking for worthy Pirates to join our crew in Lolosia.

Arrrr interested?

elements.text: I'm Archangel Aranx, the artist in charge of all the spectacular remakes of our old weapons in the Infinity style and quality. I'm glad to see you using some of the weapons we have made for you.
Ah, yes, you see. I come from the Celestial Realm, a place were Archangels, and Celestials like me reside. Is too early yet to grant you a visit there. However, I do look forward to the occasion.

Aye, we Alpha Pirates be the first of our kind. Pirates that set sail before there were even masts to hoist and islands to plunder. The O.G. scallywags! Only at the birth of a new world can we be created. 

But this time... we be upgrading our Alpha Pirate armors and blades!

If yer an Alpha Pirate of Infinity, which means ye be a Founder tier or above of the AQWorlds Infinity Kickstarter, then set sail to Lolosia to begin quest'n!
Ho, ho! If yer a pirate, then Lolosia is the place you outta be! A den of sea fair'n scullywags and brutal buccaneers. Ya'll find a ship and crew there. Specifically speak'n... mine.

Arrr. International Talk Like a Pirate Day be upon us, mateys! That glorious day o’ thee year when perfectly respectable adventurers throw grammar overboard, start yellin’ “ARRR!” at innocent landlubbers, ‘nd suddenly develop a suspicious interest in treasure, parrots, and… dare me say… BOOTY

Perhaps ye should be read'n the handy Pirate speak primer that Beleen be posting. Act smartly now!

I have managed to locate four dintic manticore in this... nexus. Help me take them down, return them to the Celestial realm, and some of them may choose you as their master.

elements.text: Where me manners? Rhubarb be the name! Honorable pirate, at yer service. I hunt treasure across the Lorian seas, savvy? Me wants all the gold coins an' the booty I can get, an' if I 'ave to cross blades along the way… aye, even better!

Alpha Pirates arrrrr feared across all the Loriann seas, ye hear? Any scallywag with a lick of sense is right to fear me crew when theys see us sailin’ into port. We be plundrin’ ev’ry bit o’ treasure fer ourselves, sendin’ that Bone-Beard straight to Davy Jones’ Locker!

Ahoy @name... I'm on a quest filled with danger, mischief, skullduggery and snacks. There are pirates around this port that have some good bounties on their skulls. And I'm not one to abandon a mission. Grab a sword and let's swashbuckle some bounties!

Looking to become a bounty Hunter like me @name ? You will have to prove to me you are up to the task, not everyone can become a Pirate Bounty Hunter.

Awwwwwwwwwwwwwwww (Captain Bone-Beard sent us to delay Rhubarb on recruiting more Alpha Pirates for his crew, while he recruits more Undead Pirates for our crew.) Arrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrgggeeeeeeeww (Therefore, we are here to present such friendly opposition, if you will.) Awwwrgooo? (Don’t get too carried away with my crewmates, could you?) Argggggghweeet! (We still gonna need them to keep competing with Rhubarb for that loot!).

Arhhhhhg! (Rhubarb's Alpha Pirates have always been a pest to us Undead Pirates, always so gallantly threatening the high seas, challenging us at any point.) Awwwwwwreeee!!! (If this new batch of Alpha Pirates comes any closer to Rhubarb's very first crew, then we are truly boned!!!)

Awwwwweeeee? (You haven't heard of Bone-Beard? That's the mightiest of us Undead Pirates, some even say he was the person skeleton behind killing the Beast of Pirate bay!) Arrrrrrrgoooooww! (Rhubarb and the boss have had this ongoing rivalry for centuries, the boss says is decades, but he hasn't been dead for that long, or Rhubarb hasn't been alive for that long.)
